Toolkit-independent native capability contracts and atomic staged file publication for .NET 10. Compose explicit providers for Windows, macOS, or experimental Linux support. No UI toolkit or dependency-injection dependencies.

Experimental Linux native capabilities for .NET 10: statx regular-file inspection, file-manager reveal, explicit executable and desktop-entry handoff, GIO discovery, and optional desktop-portal color selection. Native rename and atomic file publication are unavailable.

macOS native capabilities for .NET 10: atomic file rename and replacement, regular-file inspection, Finder reveal, explicit application handoff, LaunchServices discovery, and optional AppKit screen color selection. Depends only on Bathos.Platform and the runtime.

Windows native capabilities for .NET 10: atomic file rename and replacement, regular-file inspection, Explorer reveal, explicit executable handoff, App Paths discovery, and optional GDI screen color selection. Depends only on Bathos.Platform and the runtime.
